svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gutter: a channel 170 wide x 60 deep x 780 mm long, bent from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sheet, both ends folded up and sealed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outlet: a 32 mm hole in the bottom 40 mm from the right end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 95 mm out from the wall; fit a 32 mm tank connector.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Brackets: two 40 x 3 mm strips bent to an L, 80 mm up the wall

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 180 mm out, 250 mm each side of centre; two plugs each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the gutter sits on the brackets with its top 20 mm below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pad, 10 mm off the wall, reaching 120 mm past the pad on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right and 60 mm on the left. Fall toward the outlet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: pour water in; it all leaves by the outlet.
